files.description:
A vervet, a type of African monkey, vocalizes at Hope Ranch Zoo in Guyton, GA.

Recorded with an LG Stylus 2022.

Fun Fact: Steve the monkey of Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs franchise is this kind of Old World monkey.
files.author: TheKingOfGeeks360
